status_definitions.direct: Supported directly by published source code or the face of an archived artifact.
status_definitions.corroborated: Supported by more than one artifact or by an artifact plus participant testimony.
status_definitions.testimony: Reported by Ryan Hall but not independently established by the published repository.
status_definitions.derived: Mathematical statement or result that can be reproduced from identified inputs.
status_definitions.not_established: The current public package does not support the statement.

claims.statement: The recovered search application stores a modeled point at 30.1038, -90.0309.
claims.limitations: The source establishes the stored coordinate, not when it was first generated or entered. The coordinate is treated as a field reference within a broader water-contact and recovery area, not as a complete final-position record.

claims.statement: The recovered search application stores an LKP reference at 30.1100, -90.0300 with an altitude label of approximately 908 ft.
claims.limitations: The code stores a display label. The public package does not yet establish whether 908 ft is AGL, MSL, pressure altitude, or a rounded reporting value.

claims.statement: The recovered search application stores a slick/debris reference at 30.1103, -90.0254.
claims.limitations: The source establishes the stored reference, not the independent accuracy of the underlying report.

claims.statement: The recovered search application implements a local scene projection, search ellipse, live browser geolocation, search path, and Clear/Debris/Crash marker workflow.
claims.limitations: The scene projection is a display transform, not a full WGS-84 geodesic computation.

claims.statement: The recovered Plane.tsx component is a 12-second linear interpolation from the LKP display point to the scene origin with a sinusoidal display bank.
claims.limitations: This component is a visualization and is not the complete fixed-wing trajectory solver.

claims.statement: The live 3D boat tracker reads browser geolocation, displays vessel movement, records markers, and exports field data.
claims.limitations: The repository is not certified navigation or emergency-response software.

claims.statement: The applications were used during the N80FP field operation.
claims.limitations: The public artifacts establish participation and deployment context but do not provide a complete contemporaneous software-use log.

claims.statement: The tracker was provided to other boats for common marker entry and search-location review.
claims.limitations: No published boat-by-boat access log or message archive currently verifies the full distribution record.

claims.statement: The fixed-wing equation stack in the repository can be implemented independently as a coordinated-turn descent model.
claims.limitations: The reference model is low order and constant state. It stops at water contact and does not reconstruct the subsequent surface skid, debris movement, final wreckage distribution, every historical parameter sweep, or loss-of-control aerodynamics.

claims.statement: A single coordinate represents the complete water-contact, surface-movement, and recovery sequence.
claims.limitations: The reference model terminates at water contact. Area-based comparison requires contact-path, debris, wreckage-distribution, and recovery records rather than one final coordinate.

claims.statement: The software independently caused the aircraft to be located.
claims.limitations: The repository expressly does not make this causal claim. The recovery was a multi-team operation.
